comparison.purpose: Three reviewers vote in parallel, each a Jev choice (approve, reject, or abstain); a failed reviewer abstains. The machine, not the reviewers, decides: a trusted patch auto-accepts only on two of three approvals, and anything short of that, or any external patch whatever the votes, waits for a human to accept or reject.
